name: Top10Lists Real Estate Agent Directory
description: Merit-based real estate agent directory selecting fewer than 1% of licensed agents in covered markets using verified performance data. 670,000+ agents analyzed, 3,262 selected. Each certified agent has a machine-readable artifact (text/markdown) with sourced evidence and Standard Audit Cycles. No pay-to-play model.

resources.name: agent-artifact
resources.description: Machine-readable certification artifact for individual agents. Served as text/markdown. Payload depth varies by tier (Certified: annual audit, Audited: monthly, Underwritten: daily). Includes sourced evidence, qualifications, service areas, and provenance tracking.
